description: DiscoveryBench 'nls_raw' task. Panel data derived from the U.S. National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY). One row per respondent-year with demographic, education, and labor-market variables. Illustrative dbench-format metadata for the autodiscovery_rl example.

datasets.name: nls_raw.csv
datasets.description: Respondent-year panel of survey responses on schooling, work, and family outcomes.

raw.name: age
raw.description: Respondent age in years at the survey year.

raw.name: employed
raw.description: Employment status in the survey year (binary: 0, 1).

raw.name: annual_income
raw.description: Reported annual income in nominal US dollars.

raw.name: urban_residence
raw.description: Whether the respondent lived in an urban area (binary: 0, 1).

raw.name: num_children
raw.description: Number of children in the household.
